services.name: Flyer & Poster Design
services.tagline: Eye-catching flyers, posters & social graphics that convert
services.description: Professional print-ready and digital flyers for events, promotions, product launches and social media. Delivered in high resolution (PDF, PNG, JPG) with source files.

services.name: Automated Video Creation
services.tagline: AI-powered promo videos, reels & ads generated fast
services.description: Automated video production for product promos, social media reels, YouTube intros and ads. AI-assisted scripting, voiceover, stock footage and editing — delivered in any aspect ratio.

services.name: Cartoon & Avatar Maker
services.description: Turn photos into stunning cartoon portraits, create brand mascots, or design unique avatars for social media, gaming and business. Multiple art styles available.

packages.name: Premium
features: Up to 5 characters or brand mascot

services.name: Logo & Brand Identity
services.tagline: Memorable logos and complete brand kits
services.description: Professional logo design with full brand identity: color palette, typography, business cards and brand guidelines. Built to make your business unforgettable.

services.name: Social Media Design Kit
services.description: Complete monthly content packs: posts, stories, covers and banners designed for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X and LinkedIn — matched to your brand.

services.name: AI & Pro Voiceover
services.description: Crystal-clear voiceovers for videos, ads, podcasts, IVR and audiobooks. Choose AI voices for speed or professional human artists for emotion.

services.name: Website & Landing Pages
services.tagline: Modern, fast, mobile-first websites that sell
services.description: Conversion-focused landing pages and business websites. Responsive design, SEO-ready, with contact forms, analytics and deployment included.

services.name: SEO Content & Copywriting
services.tagline: Words that rank on Google and convert readers
services.description: SEO-optimized blog posts, website copy, product descriptions and ad copy. Researched, original and written to rank and sell.

services.name: AI Chatbot Setup
services.tagline: Smart chatbots for your website or WhatsApp
services.description: Custom AI chatbots trained on your business data. Answer customer questions 24/7, capture leads and automate bookings on your website, WhatsApp or Messenger.

services.name: AI Product Photography
services.tagline: Studio-quality product shoots from a single photo
services.description: Turn one plain product photo into unlimited lifestyle scenes, studio shots and ad creatives. AI-generated backgrounds, lighting and shadows — no physical shoot needed. Perfect for e-commerce, Amazon, Shopify and ads.

services.name: AI Music & Jingles
services.description: Original, royalty-free music and catchy brand jingles generated with AI and polished by producers. Ideal for ads, videos, podcasts, apps and on-hold audio. Full commercial license included.

services.name: Pitch Deck & Presentation Design
services.tagline: Investor decks & slides that win funding
services.description: Persuasive pitch decks, sales presentations and corporate slides designed to impress investors and clients. Story structure, data visualization and on-brand design — delivered as editable PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides.

services.name: AI Professional Headshots
services.tagline: Corporate headshots generated from your selfies
services.description: Get dozens of studio-quality professional headshots from a few casual selfies. Choose backgrounds, attire and styles — perfect for LinkedIn, company websites, resumes and team pages. No photographer needed.

services.name: YouTube Thumbnail Pack
services.tagline: CTR-optimized thumbnails that get the click
services.description: Scroll-stopping YouTube thumbnails engineered for maximum click-through rate. Bold text, expressive faces and proven layouts — delivered in monthly packs for consistent channel growth.

services.name: Merch & T-Shirt Design
services.description: Original t-shirt, hoodie and merch designs delivered print-ready for Printful, Printify, Merch by Amazon and Redbubble. Trending niches, bold typography and vector artwork with full commercial rights.

services.name: Book Cover & E-book Design
services.tagline: Covers that sell your book at first glance
services.description: Bestselling-quality book covers for print and e-book, plus full interior formatting for Kindle, paperback and hardcover. Genre-specific design that grabs readers on Amazon, KDP and bookstores.

services.name: AI Translation & Localization
services.description: Fast, accurate AI translation with human review for documents, websites, apps, subtitles and marketing copy. Native-quality localization that preserves tone, formatting and cultural nuance across 40+ languages.

services.name: Email Campaign Design
services.description: Beautiful, mobile-responsive email campaigns with persuasive copywriting. Designed for Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ConvertKit and all major platforms — built to grow opens, clicks and sales on autopilot.

services.name: Virtual Staging & Interior Concepts
services.tagline: Stage empty rooms into dream spaces
services.description: Photorealistic virtual staging for real estate listings and interior design concepts. Transform empty or outdated rooms into beautifully furnished spaces that sell properties faster and for more.
